entry.summary: Hey everyone, I'm Ashen, and I recently developed an Arduino library called OpenPager. It's designed to turn your Arduino-compatible board into a POCSAG pager transmitter using the TI CC1101 radio module. If you're into radio communications, pagers, or experimenting with wireless protocols, this might be useful for you. In this article, I'll explain what it does, its features, how to install it, and how to use it with some examples. entry.title: AIHeadshotGenerator.onlin – Try It Out and Tell Me What You Think
entry.summary: I’ve been working on a small project called AIHeadshotGenerator.online: https://aiheadshotgenerator.online/. It’s a web app that lets you turn a regular photo into a cleaner, more professional‑looking headshot you can use on LinkedIn, résumés, or team pages. The flow is simple: you upload a photo you already have, the app processes it, and you get a polished headshot with consistent framing and lighting. The goal is to make it easy for people and small teams to improve their online profiles without booking a photoshoot or dealing with complicated tools. I’d really like to understand how this feels from a user’s perspective, so I’m looking for honest feedback on things like: Whether the results look natural enough for professional use How smooth (or confusing) the upload and generation flow is What options you wish you had (backgrounds, styles, aspect ratios, etc.) Because this involves personal photos, I’m also careful about how images are handled and stored, and I’m still refining that part based on expectations around privacy and security. If you’re willing to try it, please run a photo through the site at https://aiheadshotgenerator.online/ and let me know in the comments what worked, what didn’t, and what would make you comfortable using a tool like this regularly. Thanks in advance to anyone who takes a few minutes to experiment with it and share feedback.
